verdict.rationale: Apple's support spec page documents the external connectivity side well. It lists three Thunderbolt 5 ports at up to 120Gb/s with USB 4, DisplayPort and charging, plus support for up to four external displays including HDMI. That is enough to plan a dock or display setup. However, nothing in the pack covers PCIe generation or lane allocation, or internal storage throughput, which are two of the three named parts of the story. Missing for 10: PCIe generation/lane specs, SSD/storage bandwidth specs, independent or hands-on corroboration of I/O headroom.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform has documented I/O headroom — PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage, and external connectivity specs I can plan a build or dock setup around

citations.quote: Three Thunderbolt 5 (USB-C) ports with support for: Charging, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt 5 (up to 120Gb/s), USB 4 (up to 120Gb/s)
Up to four external displays: Up to three external displays with 6K resolution at 60Hz over Thunderbolt and one external display with up to 4K resolution at 144Hz over HDMI
